C0582.title: Douyin E-commerce Reports Governance of Brand Confusion in Durable Consumer Goods
C0582.summary: In May 2026, Douyin E-commerce's Safety and Trust Center reported progress in a special governance campaign for durable consumer goods, saying that it had handled 190,000 violating merchants and 13,000 violating creators over the previous three months. The report listed brand confusion and overpromising as typical problems, explaining that some merchants promoted goods under well-known brand names while actually selling other brands, and that the platform used patrols, upfront identification, and special governance to intercept problematic goods and reduce consumer risk at the source.

references.title: Douyin E-commerce Cracks Down on Brand Confusion and Overpromising, Handles 190,000 Merchants in Three Months
